messages:
elaine: Quick intake — ChemiCorp asked for per-tenant latency budgets + automated fallback chaining when budgets hit. Need: problem statement, goals, non-goals, success metrics, and edge cases. Targeting Q2 rollout for Dedicated customers. Any immediate red flags? @rajesh @mika @jordana
rajesh: Couple q's — what's baseline traffic per tenant? p50/p95/p99 targets? encryption/regulatory constraints?
mika: Also: fallback semantics — degrade to smaller model vs cached/KV prefix? For regulated data, are we allowed to route to shared hosted models?
jordana: UX question — does the app show a degraded badge or retry spinner? Need copy for error states.
ops-bot: Deployment note: dedicated pools can be tagged per-tenant; autoscale policies can be applied but not per-tenant by default.
rajesh: Proposal for acceptance criteria:
- measurable p99 <= 300ms for warm requests for 90% tenants
- fallback activation rate <= 0.5% of requests (rolling 24h)
- no customer-visible increase in hallucination rate > 1% after fallback (eval delta)
- telemetry: event 'tenant_fallback' emitted with model_from/model_to/reason
mika: From product POV goals:
- Goal: customers can set latency_budget_ms per tenant and a fallback chain.
- Non-goal: building fully per-tenant autoscaling in this phase.
- Success metrics: adoption by 3 customers in pilot + <1% SEV incidents during pilot.
elaine: Good. For non-goals also exclude per-tenant billing changes and global routing rewrite.
rajesh: Engineering spec asks:
1) config schema (sample):
```
{"tenant_id": "chemi-123",
 "latency_budget_ms": 250,
 "fallback_chain": ["redwood-medium", "redwood-small"],
 "fallback_policy": "immediate|graceful",
 "slo_policy": {"p99_ms": 300}
}
```
2) runtime: token-level routing, kv-prefix caching compatibility, streaming session continuity when model switches
3) tests: synthetic load + eval-suite comparing outputs pre/post-fallback
mika: Security/customer constraints: ChemiCorp requires VPC-only routing for PHI. Fallback must honor that (no routing to hosted shared models). That pushes design toward private variants in Dedicated.
jordana: Suggested UI copy for fallback toast (short):
":warning: Response delayed — switching to a lower-latency model to keep things snappy. Results may be simplified."
rajesh: Edge cases:
- long-running streaming sessions crossing fallback boundary
- KV cache miss when switching models (incompatible kv shapes)
- tokens spike from prompt injection causing rapid fallback oscillation
- tenant config mis-spec (fallback_chain empty) -> must default to safe model
elaine: Owners & next steps:
- @rajesh: draft RFC + perf run by Wed
- @mika: write success metrics and pilot plan by Tue
- @jordana: error UI + copy by Tue
- @elaine: align with ChemiCorp on allowed fallback targets by EOD
Can everyone confirm? :eyes:
mika: confirmed
rajesh: confirmed, will include telemetry schema
jordana: confirmed
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up meeting Thu 10:00AM
elaine: thanks — if no objections I'll convert this into a PRD template tonight.
